paragraphs: Mentioned in Menachot 53a: Rabbi Ezra, grandson of Rabbi Avtolos, was tenth in descent from Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah, who was tenth in descent from Ezra.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Ezra is the named grandson who is introduced to Rabbi Perida in the consulted Menachot 53a passage. The two separate tenth-generation clauses are preserved. Rashi explicitly identifies Elazar ben Azaryah as the one tenth in descent from Ezra the scribe.

The whole Davidson Menachot 53a paragraph fully names Rabbi Ezra, grandson of Rabbi Avtolos, and Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah, preserving two tenth-generation clauses. The whole Vilna Rashi comment identifies Elazar ben Azaryah as tenth from Ezra the scribe; it does not resolve the grammatical antecedent of the first clause. The English follows Hyman’s account with Ezra as its subject. The inherited note remains verbatim; no genealogical or chronological admission is made.
